violation_type.title: Children Younger Than 5 - Policies - Plan for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §744.2003(2)(F))
violation_type.short_title: Children Younger Than 5 - Policies - Plan for Extreme Weather
violation_type.typical_finding: Children are not going outside due to weather conditions and are staying at the tables during hours of the program. CI: The site director let the children decided which physical activity they should play to get them moving around. The children ended up playing Simon Says.

finding_variants.text: Children are not going outside due to weather conditions and are staying at the tables during hours of the program. CI: The site director let the children decided which physical activity they should play to get them moving around. The children ended up playing Simon Says.
Operation policies were missing  how the operation will be promoting indoor and outdoor physical activity if weather does not permit to attend outdoors.
